Article 5.5: How to Submit a Withdrawal Request

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Step-by-Step: Requesting a Payout
Log in to your FFN Dashboard at fundedfuturesnetwork.com.
Confirm your Eligible to Withdraw amount on the Account Reporting screen.
Click 'CLICK HERE TO WITHDRAW' (the green button) or the link shown in the eligibility notification.
Complete the FFN Withdraw Request form with the following information:
Full name and last name
Dashboard username
Email address
Account number (starts with 7PV)
Amount requested (in USD)
Payment destination: Rise, PayPal, or Wise
Payment details: For bank wire, provide routing number, account number, name of bank, account name, and your mailing address
Click 'SEND ME MY MONEY' to submit.
Payout is requested the same day it's available in your dashboard. (Can take up to 3 business days to process)
PAYMENT METHODS: Rise is the fastest and recommended method. Bank wire: Provide routing number, account number, account holder name, and your full mailing address. PayPal: Provide the email address associated with your PayPal account. Fees apply depending on payment method.

Q: What account number do I use on the withdrawal form?

A: The account number starts with '7PV' followed by additional digits. You can find this number in your dashboard's account selector dropdown.

Q: Can I withdraw from multiple accounts in one request?

A: Yes. Submit one request per funded account. The total across all submissions in a payout event cannot exceed $10,000.

Q: What is the minimum I can withdraw?

A: $500. Requests below $500 will not be processed.
